fields.label: Welcome Paragraph 2
fields.default: Missing Omegle? Same here! We were bummed when the original Omegle went dark. But guess what? A bunch of us college kids couldn't let it die, so we created the ultimate Omegle alternative!

fields.label: Welcome Paragraph 3
fields.default: Welcome to Omegle Web — it's like the OG Omegle, but cooler!

fields.label: Deal Bullet 1
fields.default: It's the new Omegle for talking to strangers online

fields.label: Deal Bullet 2
fields.default: 100% anonymous chat — no worries, we got your privacy!

fields.label: Deal Bullet 3
fields.default: Works on your browser — no need for an Omegle app

fields.label: Deal Bullet 4
fields.default: Way better than Ome TV or Monkey (yeah, we said it!)

fields.label: Deal Footer
fields.default: Why'd we make it? 'Cause we missed random chats and meeting new people from all over. This Omegle alternative is our way of keeping the spirit alive.

fields.label: Perfect For Title
fields.default: Our Omegle Web is perfect for:

fields.label: Perfect For Bullet 3
fields.default: Finding study buddies (or procrastination partners, let's be real)

fields.label: Closing Paragraph 1
fields.default: So if you're itching to talk to strangers or just miss the OG Omegle experience, come check us out! It's free, it's fun, and who knows? You might make a new friend or find your soul meme-mate.

fields.label: Closing Paragraph 2
fields.default: Ready to dive into some anonymous chat online? Let's go!

fields.label: Closing Paragraph 3
fields.default: P.S. To our professors: This totally counts as a coding project, right? 😋

default.a: Open the site in your browser, choose text or video, and tap start. No app download is required — you can match in seconds and skip anytime.

default.q: What's included in text and video?
default.a: Text chat is instant typing with strangers. Video adds a camera when both sides are ready. Interest tags, skip, report, and block are available in every mode.

default.q: How do I stay safe while chatting?
default.a: Never share personal details you want to keep private. Use report and block if someone crosses the line. Read the community rules before your first match.

default.q: How does the site handle my privacy?
default.a: Random sessions are ephemeral unless both people choose to connect further. See our Privacy Policy for how account data, cookies, and moderation logs are handled.
